cropAdvisoryMap.Clear: Great conditions for spraying fertilizer. Early morning application recommended.
cropAdvisoryMap.Clouds: Good day for transplanting seedlings. Monitor soil moisture.
cropAdvisoryMap.Rain: Avoid pesticide application. Ensure drainage channels are clear.
cropAdvisoryMap.Drizzle: Light rain benefits germination. Check for fungal risk in paddy.
cropAdvisoryMap.Thunderstorm: Stay off the field. Secure equipment and check for waterlogging.
cropAdvisoryMap.Mist: High humidity. Watch for blight. Ventilate greenhouse crops.
cropAdvisoryMap.Haze: Reduce irrigation. Monitor crop stress levels.
